text:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — staging tenant 'northstar' goes live tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need a short prefill + jitter + fallback plan and a renewal-risk flag wired into the handoff. TL;DR checklist?
Ruben (Solutions): +1. Minimal checklist: prefill sample, jitter policy, batch targets, streaming fallback, telemetry tags.
Aisha (CS): Can we keep it to a 5-step runbook the CSM can run in <10m? Also want a single field on events: account_risk: low/med/high.
Priya (SRE): I can own infra checks. Proposal: 1) prefill (sync call) 2) warm-pool (1hr) 3) gradual traffic ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) 4) monitor error rate + latency 5) fallback to smaller model variant.
Tasha (PM): Add a step to capture customer feedback link after first 2 hours — quick survey for hallucination / quality.
Ruben (Solutions): Example prefill curl we give to customers:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Prefill: 1' \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"northstar","samples":["hi","open account info"]}'
```
Aisha (CS): Nice. Keep that in the onboarding email. Also include a note: "do not prefill >1000 tokens / user".
Priya (SRE): For jitter we recommend: linear backoff 100ms base, + random(0..200ms) per prefill attempt. Also preflight healthcheck: `GET /healthz?tenant=northstar` should be green before traffic.
Ruben (Solutions): Batching defaults: target 32ms tail latency at 8k tokens -> use batch size 4-8 for interactive paths; larger async jobs can be 32-64. If latency spikes, reduce batch size to 2 and enable kv-cache reuse.
Aisha (CS): Renewal-risk wiring — what signals do we capture? I want a single dashboard card that shows: 1) 7d avg latency > 300ms, 2) error rate > 1%, 3) negative NPS in first 48h. If any true -> account_risk = "high".
Tasha (PM): We'll add a callback to the workspace: `POST /cs/webhook` on threshold breach. CSMs should get DM from cs-bot.
cs-bot: scheduled alert created -> will DM @Aisha when account_risk != low :bell:
Priya (SRE): Streaming fallback: prefer chunked streaming; if connection fails within 5s, auto-fallback to non-streamed generate with same prompt and shorter max_tokens=256. Add header `X-Redwood-Fallback: streaming->sync`.
Ruben (Solutions): Quick sample telemetry payload for events:```json
{"event":"prefill_attempt","tenant":"northstar","account_risk":"low","prefill_tokens":45,"latency_ms":120}
```
Aisha (CS): Make sure event includes `survey_sent:true/false` so we can correlate.
Priya (SRE): Ownership table (single sentence each): CSM = runbook owner & survey; Solutions = prefill sample & config; SRE = infra checks & retry/jitter config; PM = feedback loop & dashboard acceptance criteria.
Tasha (PM): Can we add a tiny client-side snippet for prefill that apps can drop in?```js
fetch('/v1/prefill', {method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization': 'Bearer K','Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({tenant:'northstar',samples:['hello']})})
```
Aisha (CS): Perfect. Last ask: one-pager for CSM with 6 checklist bullets + copy-paste snippets above. I'll include it in the kickoff email.
Ruben (Solutions): I'll assemble the one-pager and post to /docs/onboarding-runbooks and paste link here. ETA 3h.
Priya (SRE): I'll create the healthcheck playbook and the cs-bot alert rule. ETA 5h.
Tasha (PM): I'll wire the survey and dashboard widget. ETA 24h.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team. If anyone spots a missing step ping @Aisha. :white_check_mark:
cs-bot: Deploy pipeline -> preflight passed for 'northstar' staging (build 2026.03.489). :rocket:
